QUOTE: "File types that were in scope but not indexed are recorded at build time. `cli._not_indexed_scope` ... compares the scanned files against the `path` rows and stores `ext=count` entries ... The query side reads that record"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the empty-reply scope payload carries a `not_indexed` record of file extensions that were scanned but produced no rows. That lets "absent from the repo" be told apart from "file type not indexed".
